description: This file implements a service switcher system for runtime switching between multiple services, including strategy classes, a pipeline class, and internal filtering mechanisms.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategy
classes.description: Base class for service switching strategies, meant to be subclassed for specific strategies.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategyManual
classes.description: A manual strategy allowing user to select active service.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcher
classes.description: A pipeline class that manages switching between services at runtime, with internal filtering.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcher.ServiceSwitcherFilter
classes.description: Internal filter class that passes frames only if the service is active.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcher.ServiceSwitcherFilterFrame
classes.description: Internal frame used to update active service in the pipeline.

methods.name: handle_frame
methods.description: Method to handle frames that control service switching, to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: _set_active_if_available
methods.description: Sets the active service if it is in the list of available services.

methods.name: _make_pipeline_definitions
methods.description: Creates pipeline definitions for each service with the given strategy.

methods.name: _make_pipeline_definition
methods.description: Creates a pipeline definition for a single service.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame, handling internal frames and updating active service as needed.
